description: Fork of exp018 (E=64, H=6, d_qk=32, sep Q/K) with batch-size ramp instead of fixed bs=8. Schedule: bs=1 (steps 0-499) → 2 (500-999) → 4 (1000-1999) → 8 (2000-3999) → 16 (4000-5999) → 32 (6000-8000). Each doubling at fixed step thresholds. Total tokens trained ≈ 60M (close to exp018's 65M). dataloader gives DEVICE_BS=32 sequences each step; loop slices x[:bs_now] before forward. Tests whether small-bs early descent (proven token-efficient via exp037) compounded with large-bs late refinement (gradient-noise-floor relief from exp036) beats either fixed-bs run.
